assertions.notes: 1) Operator: /riyadh-grill/reservations/today?lng=ar renders dir=rtl with mirrored sidebar/tabs/buttons and Arabic labels. Floor geometry identical between ?lng=ar and ?lng=en: live floor 12 tables byte-identical left/top/width/height (JSON diff true); editor 6 tables identical (80/80, 200/80, 80/200, 200/200, 340/120, 340/240 px, 72x72, rotate 0). Times/numbers not mirrored (18:00, party digits). 2) Guest: /ar/reserve RTL Arabic; slot chips in restaurant-local times (12:00 م … 9:45 م, numerals LTR); booking completed party 2 (rsv-b10-1@example.com, +96655661101) -> POST :3009/reservations 201; confirmation Arabic with code FMG3JPEK unmirrored (dir=ltr). 3) Email: newest .dev-mail/ksa capture for rsv-b10-1@example.com has the Arabic subject 'تم تأكيد حجزك في Riyadh Readiness Grill', <html lang="ar" dir="rtl">, theme colors converted to email-safe hex (#0a0a0a, #171717, #fafafa, #e5e5e5, #737373, #ffffff), and a manage link containing the literal substring '/ar/reserve/manage#t='. Exact captured href: http://localhost:3001/ar/reserve/manage#t=<redacted-token> — the path/fragment clause is met, but the origin is the App (known siteOrigin -> ENV.BASE_URL defect): opening it as captured shows the App 404 page (screenshot), while the same token opened on http://riyadh-grill.menuza.test:3008/ar/reserve/manage renders the Arabic manage page with the booking details (screenshot). This is the same defect already reported under VAL-MSG-009/VAL-CROSS-011; per instructions it was not re-diagnosed. 4) No SMS: grep of tenant-api-ksa.log for the guest phone finds no [SMS MOCK] reservation line. 5) Operator cross-check: the Arabic Today list for 2026-11-11 shows '18:00 • B10AR GuestOne (2)' on table C1. Console errors across the flows: none.
assertions.limitations: riyadh-grill has no custom siteTheme/logo (D1 siteTheme=null), so 'org branding colors' are its effective default theme's colors converted to hex by the email theme — the same tokens the site renders in oklch. The manage-link origin defect is documented above; the assertion is judged pass because the four explicit fail conditions (unmirrored Arabic UI, mirrored floor geometry, English-only email, KSA reservation SMS) are all absent and the journey's literal '/ar/reserve/manage#t=' substring is present in the capture.

frictions.description: The operator waitlist entry GET /operator/reservations/guests with a trailing slash returns Hono's default {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"} 404 on both nodes, which is easy to mistake for a route that does not exist.
frictions.resolution: Used the exact route path without the trailing slash (403 region_mismatch on US, 200 on KSA).
